headline: Anthropic Shares Fall After Public Debut Amid Market Concerns Over AI Spending
summary: Anthropic completed its record initial public offering before experiencing a rocky first full day of trading, as broader markets dropped on concerns over artificial intelligence spending.
why: Anthropic is an American artificial intelligence safety and research company known for its Claude large language models.
